texts.preamble: Mr. Rasesh Kumar Harkut vs The State Of Telangana on 27 July, 2022 Author: Chillakur Sumalatha Bench: Chillakur Sumalatha The Hon'Ble Dr. Justice Chillakur Sumalatha Criminal Petition No.6702 Of 2022 Order:
texts.facts: Seeking to quash the proceedings that are pending against the petitioners, who are arrayed as accused Nos.1 and 2 in Crime No.651 of 2022 of Kusaiguda Police Station, the present criminal petition is filed. In the light of the limited relief sought for, issuance of notice to respondent No.2 is felt not necessary.
texts.arguments: 3. Learned counsel for the petitioners contends that registration of case against the petitioners itself is unsustainable, as police have not role to play in the offences that are covered under the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006. Learned counsel also states that no further orders in this criminal petition are required, except to protect the petitioners from arbitrary arrest.
texts.petitioner_arguments: 3.
